sources.title: U.S. Treasury Annual Report 1922 — Refunding and Retirement of Wartime Debt
sources.date_label: Fiscal year ended June 30, 1922; report issued 1923
sources.original_term: refunding the short-dated debt; Treasury notes; loan certificates; tax certificates; gradual liquidation
sources.original_text: The report describes refinancing the short-dated debt, conversion into successive Treasury-note maturities, and retirement of the last loan certificates on October 16, 1922.
sources.translation: The 1922 Treasury annual report shows the post-war financing system entering a more advanced restructuring phase: short-dated war debt was progressively refunded into Treasury notes with staggered maturities, certificate balances fell sharply, and the last loan certificates were retired in October 1922, leaving tax certificates as the remaining certificate category.
sources.translator: FranktheWordsmith research record — paraphrase, not a quotation
sources.edition: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1922, with Appendices
sources.historical_claim: The 1922 Treasury report documents a major stage in the post-war unwinding of wartime financing: the Treasury systematically refunded short-dated debt into staggered Treasury-note maturities, reduced outstanding loan and tax certificates, and retired the last loan certificates on October 16, 1922.
sources.context: The report follows the 1921 refunding program. More than $7 billion of debt was maturing within two years at June 30, 1921; by October 31, 1922, about $4 billion had been retired or refunded. The program used successive investment offerings and maturity distribution rather than another wartime-style popular loan drive.
sources.interpretation: 1922 marks a clearer structural transition from wartime borrowing to post-war debt management. The Treasury was actively reshaping, retiring, and redistributing inherited short-dated obligations. Retirement of the last loan certificates is a useful institutional marker, while tax certificates continued for financing tied to tax-payment dates.
counter_interpretations: Treasury certificates did not disappear entirely in 1922; tax certificates continued.
Retirement of loan certificates does not mean the end of all Treasury short-term financing.
The annual report records institutional policy and results; individual statutes and Treasury circulars remain separate evidence layers.
scholarly_references: U.S. Treasury, Annual Report for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1922, with Appendices, Government Printing Office, 1923.
Federal Reserve Board, Annual Report 1922, discussion of Treasury financing and credit conditions.
related_books: Why Only Usury Invokes Allah's War?
sources.notes: Verified against FRASER Treasury Department Document No. 2913. Core refunding evidence: printed pp.3–5. Certificate retirement and remaining short-dated debt: printed pp.7–10. FRASER's text layer is automatically extracted; publication quotations should be checked against the scan.
sources.footnote_policy: Every quotation or paraphrase should resolve to the fixed 1923 GPO edition and exact printed page when available.
sources.bibliography_entry: U.S. Treasury, Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1922, with Appendices (Washington: Government Printing Office, 1923), Treasury Department Document No. 2913, pp. 3–5, 7–10.

passage_record.evidence: Printed pp.3–5 describe refinancing more than $7 billion of debt maturing within two years and distributing it into manageable maturities. Printed pp.7–8 record the decline of loan and tax certificates and the retirement of the last loan certificates on October 16, 1922. Printed pp.8–10 record the remaining short-dated debt and the policy of orderly funding and gradual liquidation.
passage_record.significance: Direct primary institutional evidence that by 1922 the wartime financing legacy was being systematically converted into a post-war debt-management structure.
passage_record.verification_note: Printed page numbers refer to the report's own pagination; FRASER's text is automatically extracted from the scan.

sources.bn_title: মার্কিন ট্রেজারি বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ১৯২২ — যুদ্ধকালীন ঋণের পুনঃঅর্থায়ন ও অবসরায়ন
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৯২২ সালের ট্রেজারি প্রতিবেদন দেখায় যে যুদ্ধোত্তর অর্থায়নব্যবস্থা আরও গভীর পুনর্গঠন পর্যায়ে প্রবেশ করেছিল। স্বল্পমেয়াদি যুদ্ধঋণ বিভিন্ন মেয়াদের ট্রেজারি নোটে পুনঃঅর্থায়ন করা হয়, সার্টিফিকেটের বকেয়া পরিমাণ কমে এবং ১৬ অক্টোবর ১৯২২ তারিখে শেষ ঋণ-সার্টিফিকেটও অবসরপ্রাপ্ত হয়।
sources.bn_context: ১৯২১ সালের পুনঃঅর্থায়ন কর্মসূচির পর ১৯২২ সালের প্রতিবেদনে তার অগ্রগতি দেখা যায়। ৩০ জুন ১৯২১-এ দুই বছরের মধ্যে পরিশোধযোগ্য ৭ বিলিয়ন ডলারের বেশি ঋণ ছিল; ৩১ অক্টোবর ১৯২২-এর মধ্যে এর প্রায় ৪ বিলিয়ন ডলার অবসরপ্রাপ্ত বা পুনঃঅর্থায়িত হয়।
sources.bn_interpretation: ১৯২২ সাল যুদ্ধকালীন ধারগ্রহণ থেকে যুদ্ধোত্তর ঋণ-ব্যবস্থাপনার দিকে আরও স্পষ্ট কাঠামোগত পরিবর্তন নির্দেশ করে। ট্রেজারি উত্তরাধিকারসূত্রে পাওয়া স্বল্পমেয়াদি ঋণকে পুনর্গঠন, অবসরায়ন ও বিভিন্ন মেয়াদে বণ্টন করছিল; তবে কর-সংক্রান্ত অর্থায়নের জন্য ট্যাক্স সার্টিফিকেট চালু ছিল।
sources.bn_notes: GPO 1923 সংস্করণের মুদ্রিত পৃষ্ঠা ৩–৫ এবং ৭–১০ যাচাই করা হয়েছে। FRASER-এর পাঠস্তর স্বয়ংক্রিয়ভাবে নিষ্কাশিত; প্রকাশিত উদ্ধৃতি স্ক্যানের সঙ্গে মিলিয়ে নিতে হবে।

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Annual Report 1923 — Completion of the First Phase of Short-Dated Debt Refunding
sources.original_term: short-dated debt; refunding; Treasury notes; Treasury certificates of indebtedness
sources.original_text: The Treasury reports that all of the $7,500,000,000 of short-dated debt maturing during the previous two and one-half years had been either retired or refunded into more manageable maturities.
sources.edition: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1923, with Appendices
sources.historical_claim: By the end of fiscal year 1923, the Treasury had completed the first phase of its refunding program: the old $7.5 billion short-dated debt had been retired or refunded into more manageable maturities.
sources.context: The refunding program replaced the inherited short-dated wartime obligations with a new maturity structure distributed through the period before the Third Liberty Loan matured in 1928.
sources.interpretation: 1923 marks completion of the first major phase of post-war debt refunding. The inherited short-dated debt was reorganized rather than simply carried forward; this does not mean all Treasury short-term financing ended.
counter_interpretations: Retirement or refunding of the old short-dated debt did not end Treasury certificates or short-term financing.
The annual report is an institutional account; statutory and security-specific evidence remain separate layers.
Substantial interest-bearing public debt remained outstanding.
related_books: Why Only Usury Invokes Allah's War?
sources.notes: Primary institutional evidence locked to printed pp. 19–23, especially p. 20. Do not equate completion of this refunding phase with the end of all short-term Treasury financing.
sources.footnote_policy: Every quotation or paraphrase should resolve to the locked printed-page locator for this edition.
sources.bibliography_entry: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1923, with Appendices (Washington: Government Printing Office, 1924), pp. 19–23.

passage_record.evidence: The Treasury states that all $7.5 billion of short-dated debt maturing during the previous two and one-half years had been either retired or refunded into more manageable maturities, with the replacement obligations distributed over later tax-payment dates.
passage_record.significance: Direct institutional evidence that the first major phase of restructuring inherited short-dated wartime debt had been completed.
passage_record.verification_note: Page lock is to the printed pagination of the 1923 annual report; FRASER corroborates the wording and pagination.

sources.bn_title: মার্কিন ট্রেজারি বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ১৯২৩ — স্বল্পমেয়াদি ঋণ পুনঃঅর্থায়নের প্রথম পর্যায়ের সমাপ্তি
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৯২৩ অর্থবছরের শেষে ট্রেজারি জানায় যে আগের আড়াই বছরে পরিশোধযোগ্য ৭.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের পুরোনো স্বল্পমেয়াদি ঋণ অবসর দেওয়া হয়েছে অথবা আরও ব্যবস্থাপনাযোগ্য মেয়াদে পুনঃঅর্থায়ন করা হয়েছে।
sources.bn_context: পুনঃঅর্থায়ন কর্মসূচিতে উত্তরাধিকারসূত্রে পাওয়া যুদ্ধকালীন স্বল্পমেয়াদি ঋণের পরিবর্তে এমন একটি নতুন মেয়াদ কাঠামো গড়ে তোলা হয়েছিল, যার পরিশোধগুলো ১৯২৮ সালে Third Liberty Loan-এর পরিপক্বতার আগ পর্যন্ত ছড়িয়ে দেওয়া হয়।
sources.bn_interpretation: ১৯২৩ যুদ্ধ-পরবর্তী ঋণ পুনঃঅর্থায়নের প্রথম বড় পর্যায়ের সমাপ্তি নির্দেশ করে। পুরোনো স্বল্পমেয়াদি ঋণ কেবল বহন করা হয়নি; এর মেয়াদ পুনর্বিন্যাস করা হয়েছিল। তবে এটিকে সব স্বল্পমেয়াদি ট্রেজারি অর্থায়নের সমাপ্তি বলা যাবে না।
sources.bn_notes: ১৯২৩ সালের ট্রেজারি বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদনের মুদ্রিত পৃষ্ঠা ১৯–২৩, বিশেষত পৃষ্ঠা ২০-এর সঙ্গে যাচাই করা হয়েছে।

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Annual Report 1973 — Reduced Deficit, Continued Treasury Borrowing, Foreign Investor Demand, and Federal Reserve Acquisitions
sources.original_term: unified budget deficit; borrowing from the public; Federal securities; foreign investors; Federal Reserve; Treasury securities
sources.original_text: On the unified budget basis the deficit for fiscal 1973 was $14.3 billion. Net receipts were $232.2 billion and outlays were $246.5 billion. Borrowing from the public amounted to $19.3 billion. As of June 30, 1973, Federal securities outstanding totaled $469 billion, comprised of $458 billion in public debt securities and $11 billion in agency securities; $343 billion represented borrowing from the public. The Federal Reserve acquired $3.8 billion of Treasury obligations. Private investors increased their holdings by $15.5 billion, including $10.3 billion by foreign investors and $5.2 billion by domestic investors.
sources.translation: ১৯৭৩ অর্থবছরে unified-budget ভিত্তিতে ঘাটতি ছিল ১৪.৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার। Net receipts ছিল ২৩২.২ বিলিয়ন ডলার এবং outlays ছিল ২৪৬.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলার। জনসাধারণের কাছ থেকে borrowing ছিল ১৯.৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার। ৩০ জুন ১৯৭৩-এ মোট Federal securities ছিল ৪৬৯ বিলিয়ন ডলার—এর মধ্যে ৪৫৮ বিলিয়ন public debt securities এবং ১১ বিলিয়ন agency securities; ৩৪৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার ছিল borrowing from the public। Federal Reserve ৩.৮ বিলিয়ন ডলারের Treasury obligations অধিগ্রহণ করে। Private investors-এর holdings ১৫.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলার বাড়ে, যার মধ্যে ১০.৩ বিলিয়ন foreign investors এবং ৫.২ বিলিয়ন domestic investors-এর।
sources.translator: Archive synthesis from the verified Treasury annual report; figures checked against the named printed pages.
sources.edition: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1973
sources.historical_claim: FY1973 reduced the unified-budget deficit to $14.3 billion, while borrowing from the public remained $19.3 billion. Treasury securities remained the dominant component of Federal securities, and foreign investors supplied $10.3 billion of the $15.5 billion increase in private holdings while the Federal Reserve acquired $3.8 billion of Treasury obligations.
sources.context: The report records a transition year after the 1971–72 monetary break. Fiscal borrowing remained substantial even as the unified-budget deficit narrowed, and the ownership data show continuing foreign and Federal Reserve demand for U.S. Treasury obligations.
sources.interpretation: 1973 is a useful transition marker: the fiscal deficit narrowed, but Treasury borrowing from the public remained near the prior two years' level. Foreign investors accounted for the majority of the increase in private holdings, while the Federal Reserve also increased its Treasury holdings. These are documented financing and ownership relationships, not by themselves proof of causation or policy motive.
counter_interpretations: The $14.3B unified-budget deficit and $19.3B borrowing from the public are distinct measures because the Treasury reconciliation includes changes in cash and other financing accounts.
Foreign investor holdings and foreign official holdings should not be conflated without a separate ownership classification; the cited passage establishes foreign private-investor holdings.
The $3.8B Federal Reserve acquisition records a holdings change and does not by itself establish motive or direct Treasury financing.
Federal securities include agency securities as well as Treasury public debt securities; these categories should remain distinct.
related_books: Why Only Usury Invokes Allah's War?
sources.notes: Verified against Treasury Department Document No. 3260. Printed pp. 3–4 establish fiscal operations and financing reconciliation; pp. 11–16 cover Federal debt structure, ownership, Federal Reserve acquisitions, foreign investors, and Treasury financing. Printed page labels control over OCR.

sources.bn_title: মার্কিন ট্রেজারি বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ১৯৭৩ — কম ঘাটতি, Treasury borrowing, foreign investor demand ও Federal Reserve acquisitions
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৯৭৩ অর্থবছরে unified-budget ঘাটতি ১৪.৩ বিলিয়ন ডলারে নেমে আসে, কিন্তু public borrowing ছিল ১৯.৩ বিলিয়ন ডলার। Federal securities ছিল ৪৬৯ বিলিয়ন ডলার। Private investors-এর holdings ১৫.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলার বাড়ে, যার ১০.৩ বিলিয়ন foreign investors-এর; Federal Reserve ৩.৮ বিলিয়ন ডলারের Treasury obligations অধিগ্রহণ করে।
sources.bn_context: ১৯৭১–৭২-এর monetary break-এর পর ১৯৭৩ সালে fiscal deficit কমলেও Treasury borrowing এবং U.S. debt-এর foreign investor demand গুরুত্বপূর্ণ ছিল।
sources.bn_interpretation: ১৯৭৩ একটি গুরুত্বপূর্ণ transition marker: deficit কমলেও public borrowing প্রায় আগের দুই বছরের স্তরে থাকে; private holdings বৃদ্ধির বড় অংশ foreign investors-এর মাধ্যমে আসে এবং Federal Reserve-এর Treasury holdings-ও বাড়ে।
sources.bn_notes: Treasury Department Document No. 3260-এর মুদ্রিত pp. 3–4 ও 11–16 দিয়ে যাচাই করা হয়েছে।

passage_record.evidence: $14.3B unified-budget deficit; $19.3B borrowing from public; $469B Federal securities; $458B public debt securities; $343B borrowing from public; $3.8B Federal Reserve acquisition of Treasury obligations; $15.5B increase in private holdings, including $10.3B foreign and $5.2B domestic.
passage_record.significance: Primary institutional evidence of fiscal financing and ownership patterns during the post-1971 monetary transition.

sources.title: U.S. Treasury Annual Report 1974 — Sharp Deficit Reduction, Foreign Redemptions, Federal Reserve Acquisitions, and Creation of the Federal Financing Bank
sources.original_term: unified budget deficit; borrowing from the public; foreign-held Treasury issues; Federal Reserve; Federal Financing Bank; Treasury financing
sources.original_text: On the unified budget basis the deficit for fiscal 1974 was $3.5 billion. Borrowing from the public amounted to $3.0 billion. As of June 30, 1974, Federal securities outstanding totaled $487 billion, comprised of $475 billion in public debt securities and $12 billion in agency securities; $346 billion represented borrowing from the public. Foreign investors' holdings of public debt securities declined $2.6 billion, including a $3.4 billion decline in special nonmarketable issues and a $0.8 billion increase in marketable holdings. The Federal Reserve System acquired $5.5 billion of public debt securities, raising its holdings to $80.5 billion. The Federal Financing Bank was created by the Federal Financing Bank Act of 1973 to coordinate Federal and federally assisted borrowing and reduce borrowing costs and market disruption.
sources.translation: ১৯৭৪ অর্থবছরে unified-budget ভিত্তিতে ঘাটতি ছিল ৩.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলার এবং জনসাধারণের কাছ থেকে borrowing ছিল ৩.০ বিলিয়ন ডলার। ৩০ জুন ১৯৭৪-এ মোট Federal securities ছিল ৪৮৭ বিলিয়ন ডলার—এর মধ্যে ৪৭৫ বিলিয়ন public debt securities এবং ১২ বিলিয়ন agency securities; ৩৪৬ বিলিয়ন ডলার ছিল borrowing from the public। Foreign investors-এর public debt securities holdings ২.৬ বিলিয়ন ডলার কমে; এর মধ্যে special nonmarketable issues ৩.৪ বিলিয়ন কমে এবং marketable holdings ০.৮ বিলিয়ন বাড়ে। Federal Reserve System ৫.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের public debt securities অধিগ্রহণ করে এবং তার holdings ৮০.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারে পৌঁছায়। Federal Financing Bank Act of 1973-এর মাধ্যমে Federal Financing Bank গঠিত হয় Federal ও federally assisted borrowing সমন্বয় এবং borrowing cost ও market disruption কমানোর উদ্দেশ্যে।
sources.translator: Archive synthesis from the verified Treasury annual report; figures and propositions checked against named printed pages.
sources.edition: Annual Report of the Secretary of the Treasury on the State of the Finances for the Fiscal Year Ended June 30, 1974
sources.section: Financial Operations; Federal Debt Management; International Affairs
sources.historical_claim: FY1974 sharply reduced the unified-budget deficit and public borrowing requirement. At the same time, foreign investors reduced holdings of public debt securities, while the Federal Reserve acquired $5.5 billion of public debt securities. The Treasury also documented the creation of the Federal Financing Bank as a new institutional mechanism for coordinating federally assisted borrowing and reducing market disruption.
sources.context: Fiscal 1974 followed the post-1971 monetary transition and was marked by high inflation, restrictive Federal Reserve policy, rising interest rates, the oil shock, and continuing international monetary reform. Treasury financing shifted materially as foreign redemptions of special nonmarketable issues increased market financing needs, while the Federal Financing Bank was established to consolidate and coordinate Federal and federally assisted borrowing.
sources.interpretation: 1974 is a transition marker showing that a much smaller unified-budget deficit did not eliminate Treasury financing operations. Foreign-held special nonmarketable securities were redeemed on net, increasing market financing needs, while the Federal Reserve increased its Treasury holdings. The Federal Financing Bank created a new institutional layer for Federal and federally guaranteed borrowing. These are documented institutional relationships; they should not be treated as proof of a single financing motive.
counter_interpretations: The $3.5B unified-budget deficit and $3.0B borrowing from the public are distinct because the Treasury financing reconciliation includes changes in cash and other means of financing.
Foreign investor holdings declined overall, but marketable holdings increased $0.8B while special nonmarketable holdings declined $3.4B; these categories should not be conflated.
The $5.5B Federal Reserve acquisition records an increase in holdings and does not by itself establish motive or direct Treasury financing.
The Federal Financing Bank was designed to coordinate and replace existing federally assisted obligations; its creation should not be described as automatically creating new net Federal debt.
The report's statements about reducing borrowing costs and market disruption are Treasury's contemporaneous institutional rationale.
related_books: Why Only Usury Invokes Allah's War?
sources.notes: Verified against Treasury Department Document No. 3263. Printed pp. 3–4 establish fiscal operations; pp. 12–19 cover financing, debt structure, ownership, foreign investor holdings and Federal Reserve acquisitions; the report's introductory international/federal-finance discussion on printed page xxvi records the Federal Financing Bank's creation and mandate. Printed page labels control over OCR.

sources.bn_title: মার্কিন ট্রেজারি বার্ষিক প্রতিবেদন ১৯৭৪ — ঘাটতির তীব্র হ্রাস, foreign redemptions, Federal Reserve acquisitions ও Federal Financing Bank-এর সৃষ্টি
sources.bn_historical_claim: ১৯৭৪ অর্থবছরে unified-budget ঘাটতি ৩.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারে নেমে আসে এবং public borrowing ছিল ৩.০ বিলিয়ন ডলার। Foreign investors-এর public debt holdings ২.৬ বিলিয়ন ডলার কমে, Federal Reserve ৫.৫ বিলিয়ন ডলারের public debt securities অধিগ্রহণ করে এবং Federal Financing Bank গঠিত হয়।
sources.bn_context: ১৯৭৪ সালে উচ্চ inflation, restrictive Federal Reserve policy, rising interest rates, oil shock এবং আন্তর্জাতিক monetary reform-এর মধ্যে Treasury financing কাঠামো পরিবর্তিত হয়।
sources.bn_interpretation: ১৯৭৪ দেখায় যে budget deficit কমে গেলেও Treasury financing operations অব্যাহত থাকে; foreign-held special nonmarketable issues-এর net redemption market financing-এর প্রয়োজন বাড়ায়, আর Federal Financing Bank federally assisted borrowing সমন্বয়ের নতুন institutional layer তৈরি করে।
sources.bn_notes: Treasury Department Document No. 3263-এর মুদ্রিত pp. 3–4, 12–19 এবং xxvi দিয়ে যাচাই করা হয়েছে।

passage_record.evidence: $3.5B unified-budget deficit; $3.0B borrowing from public; $487B Federal securities; $475B public debt securities; $346B borrowing from public; foreign public-debt holdings -$2.6B; special nonmarketable -$3.4B; marketables +$0.8B; Federal Reserve +$5.5B to $80.5B; Federal Financing Bank created to coordinate Federal and federally assisted borrowing.
passage_record.significance: Primary institutional evidence of financing, ownership, Federal Reserve holdings, foreign redemptions, and the creation of the Federal Financing Bank during the post-1971 monetary transition.
